critical_A1_notes.1JB0: Source-geometry caution: the reference quinone C–O distances are approximately 1.42 Å and have official ligand-geometry flags. This is a numbering/alignment reference, not a chemical-geometry gold standard; released experimental density is unavailable.
critical_A1_notes.7DKZ: Source-geometry caution: deposited quinone C–O distances are 1.42110–1.43833 Å with substantial ring nonplanarity. Retain these native-coordinate measurements as a model record; hold quantitative A₁ chemical-geometry or redox interpretation. Broad model-phased density does not clear this concern.
critical_A1_notes.9KZ9: Source-geometry caution: deposited quinone C–O distances are 1.39311–1.39568 Å, with official carbonyl bond Z scores about +7.8 to +7.9. Strong density and ring planarity do not establish correct carbonyl chemistry; hold quantitative A₁ chemical-geometry/redox interpretation.

diagnostic_density_method: Trilinear point samples at full-precision native deposited positions from hash-bound source maps; same contour recipe as packaged sections. Values/reference levels are within-map display context, NOT standardized cross-map scores, coordinate uncertainty, occupancy estimates, proof of atom placement or automatic acceptance thresholds. No smoothing, refinement, EM normalization, masking or atom exclusion. 351 modeled cofactor diagnostic oxygen points + 37 assigned water oxygens; unavailable/unmodeled sites are not invented.

axial_geometry_review.scope: Descriptive full-precision native Mg/histidine geometry. No fitted positions, coordinate uncertainty, tautomer assignment or coordination validation.

visual_screen_method: Scoped visual inspection of all 462 packaged section/mesh assets across 39 available protomers, using 85 review sheets across two stages, plus eight targeted native planes. Broad envelopes/local feature and contour sensitivity only; not all-atom fit adjudication, half-map validation or chemical approval. 1JB0 remains unavailable and not visually reviewed.
